bibliographic.abstract: The synthesis of IrI3 at high pressure in its layered honeycomb polymorph is reported. Its crystal structure is refined by single crystal X-ray diffraction. Faults in the honeycomb layer stacking are observed by single crystal diffraction, synchrotron powder diffraction, and transmission electron microscopy. A previously unreported "hyperhoneycomb" polymorph of IrI3 (β-IrI3), is also described - Its structure in space group Fddd is determined by single crystal XRD. Both materials are highly-resistive diamagnetic semiconductors, consistent with a low spin d6 configuration for Ir(III). The two- and three-dimensional Ir arrays in these polymorphs of IrI3 are analogous to those found in the α- and β- polymorphs of Li2IrO3, although the Ir electron configurations are different.

samples.sample_description: Monoclinic layered honeycomb polymorph synthesized by high pressure synthesis (quench cooling from 700 or 800 °C).
Orthorhombic 3D hyperhoneycomb polymorph synthesized by high pressure synthesis (annealed at 900 °C, 6 GPa for 1 hour, slowly cooled).

datasets.dataset_description: SCXRD data collected on a Bruker D8 Quest Eco using graphite monochromated Mo Kα radiation (λ = 0.71073 Å) to determine crystal structures.
PXRD patterns collected using a Bruker D8 Advance Eco with Cu Kα radiation (λ= 1.5418 Å) for phase identification and Le Bail fitting.

High-resolution synchrotron powder diffraction data acquired at Beamline 11-BM at the Advanced Photon Source at Argonne National Laboratory at a wavelength of 0.4582 Å to characterize stacking faults.

TEM imaging and atomic-resolution high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy performed on a Titan Cubed Themis 300 double Cs-corrected microscope operated at 300 kV to characterize stacking faults.
Magnetic susceptibility measurements collected on a Quantum Design PPMS (Dynacool) under an applied field of 0.1 Tesla using a vibrating sample magnetometer (VSM) option.
Resistivity measurements carried out on QD PPMS Dynacool with platinum wires attached to samples using DuPont 4922N silver paint.
Diffuse reflectance data collected at ambient temperature on a Cary 5000i UV-VIS-NIR spectrometer equipped with an internal DRA-2500 integrating sphere to determine optical band gaps.
